title: Phase 51D-2: Extract validate route orchestration
objective: Extract POST /validate orchestration from main_web.py into app/services/validation_service.py using the same behavior-first vertical extraction pattern as Phase 51B (run_service) and Phase 51C-2 (compare_service). This is a behavior-preserving production refactor with NO production behavior changes. The runtime-snapshot parity call documented in Phase 51D-1 is preserved EXACTLY.
what_moved: Runtime snapshot resolution (parity call, captured unused) -> inside execute_validate_route
Stage A: enum validation -> inside execute_validate_route
Stage B: numeric field validation (9 fields, exact max values) -> inside execute_validate_route
Stage C: schema build validation (if not errors: gate, ValueError catch) -> inside execute_validate_route
what_did_not_move: Auth redirect (get_current_user -> RedirectResponse /login) - stays in main_web.py (route-owned)
ValidateRouteDeps construction with all 11 callables - stays in main_web.py (route wires deps)

_collect_form_snapshot, _project_workspace_from_snapshot, _canonical_project_type, _normalize_template_source, _resolve_runtime_snapshot_source, _build_schema_from_form, _validate_numeric_field - all stay in main_web.py (passed as deps)
check_runtime_allowed (imported from scenario_state_service) - stays imported in main_web.py (passed as dep)
SnapshotInputError (parity dep, NOT used by /validate today) - stays imported in main_web.py (passed as dep)
PROJECT_TYPES / SCENARIOS constants - stay in main_web.py module scope (passed as deps)
Financial formulas / model / project factories / fixture CSVs / schema migrations - unchanged
Validation behavior (Stage A -> B -> C, error accumulation, etc.) - unchanged
allowed_behavior_changes: None. This is a behavior-preserving refactor.

runtime_snapshot_parity_call_preservatio.rationale: The Phase 51D-1 characterized runtime-snapshot parity quirk is preserved EXACTLY. The service calls deps.resolve_runtime_snapshot_source when (saved_state + active_scenario_id) OR (user_created), captures only the first tuple element as runtime_snapshot, discards the rest (scenario_record, warning, effective_runtime_origin), and does NOT use the captured snapshot downstream (annotated with noqa: F841 to make this explicit).
runtime_snapshot_parity_call_preservatio.do_not_remove_as_cleanup: The Phase 51D-1 documentation explicitly requires that this call be preserved as-is, NOT removed as cleanup in 51D-2. It is preserved for parity with /run and /compare.

read_only_invariant.rationale: validation_service.py and the /validate route do NOT call any persistence / record_* helper. No record_compare_run (does not exist), no record_workspace_runtime, no record_export, no update_scenario_last_run_summary, no db.add / db.commit / db.flush / session.add / session.commit.

recommended_next_phase: Phase 51E-1: Apply the same vertical extraction pattern to the next god-module hotspot in main_web.py. Candidate targets (in order of body size, all > 50 non-blank lines): POST /scenarios/state/draft (line 2181), POST /scenarios/save (line 2316), POST /scenarios/{scenario_id}/duplicate (line 2446), POST /scenarios/add (line 2520), POST /projects/create (line 2030). For each, the proposed pattern is: (1) characterization phase (e.g. phase5x1_*) — pin current behavior, no production code change; (2) vertical extraction phase (e.g. phase5x2_*) — extract orchestration body into a service module, keep the route thin, write characterization + extraction test suites. /run, /compare, and /validate (post-51D-2) will serve as the canonical templates.
